name: spreadsheet-agent-edit
description: An agent opens a spreadsheet, reads it, edits it, decides the edit was wrong and restores the version the write door saved for it. Drives the worker's sheet_* builtins end to end and the admin's agent-presence browser case. The `__PAGE__` and `__VERSION__` placeholders are filled in by whichever harness runs it: neither a page id nor a version id exists when a scenario is written.

turns.text: Let me see what is in this workbook before I touch it.
One sheet. Reading the used range.
Adding the quarter's figures and a total.
Those were last quarter's numbers — putting the sheet back as I found it.
I wrote the wrong quarter's figures and restored the version saved before my first edit, so the sheet is back where it was.
